body:
My boyfriend and I went to a party last weekend and bought our usual GBL to enjoy the night.  I have yet to have a bad experience with G because I am very careful with how much I take and usually supplement it with tyrosine (and at least 50mg B6 and 1000mg vit C) which keeps me from getting tired and lethargic while on G.
I had tried meth at a party a couple months ago with G and it was a fantastic high, but the day after I was miserable.  I had a terrible mental depression (not emotional like an E hangover) and I couldnt sleep for many hours even after the high was gone.  I bought a 50 bag at the party and decided I would do it a little differently, so we went home.  I had not taken any tyrosine yet, because even though it helps to give me more energy while on G, it also brings down the intoxication level.  Tyrosine is a GREAT supplement to have on hand when using G.  It helps to keep me from going into a hole
.  I also thought that I would take the meth orally instead of snorting because it makes the high comeon and down more gradual and lasts longer.
I took one bump, and took the capsule that I put the meth in.  The meth kicked almost instantly because of the first bump, and I never had the normal craving
.  My boyfriend and I made love and talked for literally 5 hours, spreading normal doses of G during the time [total of 4ml].  I was hyper beyond belief, and the confidence level it gave me to talk about anything on my mind was wonderful.  G normally makes me very horny, and the combination with meth is great for sexual purposes.  It reduced my inhibitions to almost nothing and I was able to concentrate on sex for a much longer period of time than I normally would be able to.  The combination of G and speed balances the other so as to keep the good effects and diminish the negative affects of each.
After about 7 hours since the first dose of meth, I began to feel the familiar beginnings of the comedown, but it wasnt near as intense and fast as the past few times I had tried it, and I believe it was due to the fact I had taken it orally, instead of insufflating it.  I took 2000mg of tyrosine with vit b6 and c.  I could feel the effects of the meth coming back on after only 20 minutes (on an empty stomach).  Rather than bring me down, it prolonged the effects of the drug, bringing me down much more gradually and softer than I could have imagined having had such an awful time with it the last times.   I took 500mg of tyrosine again at 9am and again every couple hours for the rest of the day.  Eventually my body was aching and exhausted due to lack of any sleep the night before, but I had virtually no mental hangover.
Eventually my body was aching and exhausted due to lack of any sleep the night before, but I had virtually no mental hangover.
The comedown was long and gradual and very acceptable considering the fact I had no sleep and had been high for almost 9 hours.  I had no desire to sleep til about 11pm the next evening.
I concluded that supplementing a meth experience with tyrosine helps tremendously with the comedown and also prolongs the effects of the drug
.  It HAS to be taken with alot of vit B6 and c to work though.  It will be a staple when I speed in the future.
All in all, my opinion of speed changed dramatically.  The G gives me a wonderful inebriation and body high, while the meth gives me loads of energy and positive mental vibes.
[Reported Dose: '2mg meth, 4ml GBL']
